caption: The drawing depicts a rectangular niche with a rounded arch at the top and two small projections at the upper corners, all filled with vivid, multicolored patterns. The niche's border features wavy lines in pink, red, black, and cream hues. The top background is turquoise with large, red flowers, paisley shapes, and smaller blossoms outlined in black and white. Inside the niche, a male figure with a beard and dark hair stands in the center, wearing a blue robe with a red collar and a white sash draped over his shoulder and tied at the waist. The figure's right hand is raised, while his left arm supports a smaller child figure dressed in red, seated against his side. The interior background behind the figures contains vertical red stripes and a yellow gradient with red strokes radiating outward. The composition is symmetrical and each section is detailed with intricate decorative elements. The predominant colors are turquoise, red, white, black, and blue, contributing to a vibrant, folk-art style appearance.
title: Retablo of Saint Joseph
